value.title: In-process UTC offset and process ancestry (issues #127, #128)
#127: local UTC offset in-process (time local_offset_at, refresh_tz on macOS)
value.success: local_utc_offset_minutes reads the offset with the time crate (libc localtime_r, the ADR 0001 path) and launches nothing; every caller gets the same minutes as date +%z.

value.title: Spike: macOS process args in-process without unsafe (sysctl KERN_PROCARGS2 via the smallest safe crate)
value.success: A probe reads ppid, ucomm and argv for this process, its parent and pid 1 in-process and the result is compared with ps -o ppid= -o ucomm= -o args=; the dependency choice and the unreadable-args fallback are recorded.

value.title: #128: registration ancestry in-process on macOS, 32-ancestor cap kept
value.success: read_native_process on macOS reads parent and kernel name in-process for every ancestor and reads each host-named ancestor's argv with one single-pid /bin/ps, cached for the registration, at most one per host-named ancestor (ruling C27 as amended after the review of #134); native and paneless registration give the same results.

value.title: spawn_sites guards for date.utc-offset and ps.registration-native-process
value.success: crates/testkit/tests/spawn_sites.rs fails if either launch returns.

value.title: Readings, docs and PR: private-daemon deltas, difficulties row, PR closing #127 and #128
value.success: Private-daemon counter deltas recorded; docs/difficulties.md resolved row; the performance seat takes the live before and after (AC4); gates pass; PR with Delivers line.

tk-0001.assertion: A test compares local_utc_offset_minutes with date +%z now, and local_offset_at with a fixed TZ across a DST boundary, from a multithreaded process; the spawn counter does not move.

tk-0002.assertion: The probe output for self, parent and pid 1 is recorded in assets/evidence with the ps line beside it, and the chosen crate, its licence, release date and new transitive crates are named.

tk-0003.assertion: The existing registration tests pass unchanged; a test walks this test process's real ancestry the production way and matches ps for each ancestor, launching ps only for host-named ones; registration tests count one argv read per host-named ancestor (C27 as amended).

tk-0004.assertion: Reintroducing either launch in a scratch copy fails the guard; restoring passes.

tk-0005.assertion: Private-daemon readings show date.utc-offset at 0 across FYI reads (each reads the offset) and at rest, and ps.registration-native-process at 1 per paneless registration over a real chain (C27); the live before and after pair is the performance seat's.
just ddocs-check passes; the PR body has a Delivers line and closes #127 and #128.
